executionContract.temporaryProjectRoot: Create all historical fixture projects under a temporary directory outside tracked source.

executionContract.compileSmoke: Run go test ./... inside each generated project after go mod tidy.
executionContract.repeatGeneration: Run diff -ru between two independently generated outputs and require clean repeat generation.
executionContract.reportSchema: Emit gofly.generated_version_compat_report.v1 with profile, generated files, goTest, repeatGenerationDiff, expectedDiff, and verification.
